verdict.rationale: Meta's Muse safety blog says conversation trajectories are used in training by default after PII sanitization, and users can opt out entirely with a simple switch in Muse settings. That directly gives the user control over training use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the switch exists and works, detailed settings documentation (scope, retroactivity, per-conversation control), and an opt-in default rather than opt-out.
